description: Producer-derived nonzero-value-ballot witness for C_prepare_vballot_preserved: proposal at origin 1, preaccept at peers 0 and 2, recovery at peer 2, report by peer 0, registered codec decode. Compare decoded VBallot with the producer value tag.

harness.description: Single-threaded real handler and real serialization prefix with bounded constructor-equivalent storage and buffered peer links.
semantic_changes: Network and run-loop scheduling replaced by serial dispatch of actual serialized messages; unrelated messages remain buffered.
Constructor goroutines omitted; only empty used fields initialized and instance capacity reduced to 16.

legality.derivation: Bounded empty replicas reproduce constructor fields for N=5,F=2,Thrifty=true,Dreply=true,Durable=false and replace TCP writers with buffers. The origin handlePropose allocates 1.0 and broadcasts real PreAccept messages to preferred peers 0 and 2; both decode and dispatch those messages. Their replies to the origin remain pending. Replica 2 invokes startRecoveryForInstance on that known uncommitted slot; the generated Prepare is decoded and delivered to replica 0. The real handlePrepare/replyPrepare/SendMsg writes its report, then the coordinator registered New/Unmarshal decodes it. This serial schedule is a permitted handler interleaving; it adds no duplicates or reorder on an exercised link. Recovery is invoked directly rather than simulating the watcher delay: no timing or automatic-trigger proposition is checked. Unused links keep pending bytes. All observed state and transport buffers belong to one test goroutine.
legality.applicability: A local message-preservation check, not a deployment or full recovery simulation. Sixteen slots suffice for sole slot 0 and no changed target code or dependencies.
unresolved: Does not execute the final recovery-selection handler or application endpoint.
alternatives: No direct fabricated PrepareReply is supplied.
No reply is selected according to its observed value.

grounding.derivation: The typed PrepareReply interface includes a separate VBallot; handlePrepare populates it from the stored value tag, and handlePrepareReply explicitly compares it to select prior supported metadata. SendMsg and replicaListener constitute serialization of that typed report, with no intermediate VBallot reconstruction. Preserving this consumed field is the local implementation responsibility; this is derived from composed producer/interface/consumer duties, not from assuming consensus correctness or treating the discrepancy itself as normative authority.
grounding.applicability: Legal non-Byzantine handler-produced PrepareReply delivered without byte loss to a fresh object from the registered New method, in volatile thrifty operation.
unresolved: No global agreement, recovery completion or application-order consequence is asserted.
alternatives: Promise Ballot is distinct from VBallot; preserving only Ballot does not supply the selected value context.
Zero VBallot would mask an omission; the fixed prefix establishes an original ballot of 1.
PreAcceptReply preserves VBallot through its own codec; it is not an alternate decoder for PrepareReply.

observable_properties.description: Decoded value ballot equals the producer-reported value tag for the same message identity.

uncertainties: This comparison does not measure a consensus decision divergence.
